title: Normalized free triangle in independent localizations
statement: For an additive autoequivalence F of a Grothendieck abelian C, and independently chosen ordinary derived categories of C and IsoAlgebra F, there is a normalized free-resolution datum R. Its heart iterates and differential satisfy the summand formulas of [lem-sf-free-derived-weil-resolution]; R.differential and R.delta localize that differential and its canonical SES boundary, with the standard exact-functor comparison, and form a distinguished triangle with the specified localized free counit. No boundary calculus or exact sequence of Hom groups is assumed.

source.place: Tags 0149, 0152 and 015F; parent calculus steps 1--2 and normalized free-resolution steps 5--9.

proof.text: Extract the heart short exact sequence from the proved free resolution using Grothendieck derived models in one universe. This heart data does not depend on the later localizations.

Use fully faithful whiskering by localization to descend the termwise differential and canonical natural SES boundary, conjugated by the standard exact-functor comparison. Identify the counit with the localized original counit. On representatives the triangle is isomorphic to the SES triangle; use essential surjectivity for all derived objects.
